# VNV Events

VNV Events is a South Florida event planning and event production company serving Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach.

## Main Services

- Wedding planning
- Corporate events
- Quinceaneras
- Baby showers
- Event rentals
- Flowers and decor
- DJ, sound and lighting
- Photo and video
- Catering coordination

## Main Public Pages

- Home: https://vnvevents.com/
- Services: https://vnvevents.com/service-areas-in-south-florida/
- Locations: https://vnvevents.com/locations/
- Forums: https://vnvevents.com/forums/
- Contact / Quote: https://vnvevents.com/contact/

## Main Service Areas

- Miami-Dade
- Broward
- Palm Beach
- Miami
- Doral
- Fort Lauderdale
- West Palm Beach
